work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CXLV erects the see of Dubuque in the Wisconsin Territory west of the Mississippi, taken from St Louis; LF31514 → LF31526 across a mark LF31517, a page-head mark LF31520 and page number 213 LF31523; the opening of the derogation is garbled in OCR (rere volumus … / » quae, LF31549–31550) and remains literal; complete 28 July 1837 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF31498–31498; the source closing at LF31561–31564 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima octava iulii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo sep- timo, pontificatus Nostri anno septimo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
